name: creatordesk-ai
description: CreatorDesk AI - fully local video clipping and editing desk (FastAPI backend + Vite/React frontend)

scripts.backend: cd backend && if not exist venv\Scripts\python.exe (python -m venv venv) && call venv\Scripts\activate.bat && pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.frontend: cd frontend && if not exist node_modules (npm install) && npm run dev
